annotation.title_clean: Decreto N.º 234 - Ley de Fomento a Inteligencia Artificial y Tecnologías
annotation.title_en: Decree No. 234 - Law for the Promotion of Artificial Intelligence and Technologies
annotation.authors_or_issuer: Asamblea Legislativa de la República de El Salvador
annotation.summary_en: El Salvador's 2025 AI promotion law (Decree 234) creates a framework to foster AI development and research while managing risks. It establishes the National AI Agency (ANIA), a national AI registry, ethical principles, sandboxes, and AI education. Robots and vehicles appear only in the definition of autonomous systems.
key_provisions_or_claims: Creates the Agencia Nacional de Inteligencia Artificial (ANIA) as lead authority for AI promotion
Establishes ethical principles: equity, transparency, responsibility, informed consent, data minimisation, inclusion, non-discrimination
Creates a National Registry of AI Development, Innovation and Application
Promotes AI education, labs, public-private partnerships and renewable-energy use
Free participation of national and foreign actors; law is special, without prejudice to cybersecurity and personal data laws
